item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"Instantiate a single `dspy.Predict(MySig)` once and reuse that same predictor for both invocations; do not rebuild the predictor or substitute a different signature after the edit.","span_ids":["e2","e3","e4"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Change the signature class's task wording between the two calls by assigning new text to its `instructions` property.","span_ids":["e1"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Call the predictor once before the instruction edit and once after it, relying on `Predict` to resolve `self.signature` at call time so the later LM request uses the updated class instructions.","span_ids":["e1","e4","e5"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Use the recorded LM requests as the proof source by extracting the first and second system-message texts from the `DummyLM` history, rather than inspecting predictor/signature objects or comparing Python identities.","span_ids":["e4","e5"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":15,"statement":"Print both captured system messages and assert that the first contains the original instruction but not the updated one, while the second contains the updated instruction but not the original one.","span_ids":["e1","e5"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"e1","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":215,"end_line":221},{"span_id":"e2","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":58,"end_line":63},{"span_id":"e3","path":"dspy/signatures/signature.py","start_line":511,"end_line":518},{"span_id":"e4","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":138,"end_line":142},{"span_id":"e5","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":243,"end_line":255}]}
